verifiedPasses.finding: The active V1.6 Release Candidate identity is explicit, versioned, non-consumer-eligible, and bounded to V1.5.1 as the current Stable rollback baseline.
The frozen V1.6 qualification matrix is complete at 24 verified / 0 unverified / 0 not applicable.
All nine Integral Platform Systems were explicitly evaluated for the shared presentation-system Release Candidate boundary. This evidence does not itself grant Stable or production readiness.
Applicable shared design-system rendered, human, assistive-technology, accessibility, and regression evidence is accepted for the qualified source and recorded scope.
Representative performance evidence is accepted only for its recorded environment and does not transfer downstream automatically.
V1.5.1 remains the verified current Stable and rollback target while V1.6 is Release Candidate.
Repository CI rejects unapproved external GitHub Actions, requires approved immutable 40-character action SHAs, and rejects unsafe Node runtime overrides.
Repository front-door documentation was reconciled to V1.5.1 Stable and V1.6 Release Candidate truth at commit 294e721c6fc56afcde62f7fe70c96e9d711557b1.

blockers.finding: Authoritative GitHub reports main protected=false with branch protection disabled and no required status-check contexts.
blockers.requiredResolution: Protect the authoritative default branch with the applicable pull-request, required-check, exact-head/up-to-date, force-push, deletion, and auditable-bypass controls required by GoreeCloud repository governance, then verify the live host state.

blockers.finding: The verified machine Platform Contract v0.2 task state represents the older seven-system model, while current Production Readiness and Stable qualification require all nine Integral Platform Systems. No authoritative current nine-system goreecloud.platform.yaml schema or explicit shared-design-system manifest exception was verified.
blockers.requiredResolution: Resolve current Platform Contract applicability and machine schema for shared platform libraries/design systems. Do not create a stale seven-system manifest merely to satisfy file presence.

blockers.finding: No exact-candidate repository/Git-history secret scan result was verified for the V1.6 Stable decision.
blockers.requiredResolution: Run and preserve an approved exact-candidate secret/history scan; any possible exposure must be handled through required revocation/rotation and evidence.

blockers.finding: Immutable CI action pin integrity is verified, but no exact-candidate vulnerability report covering applicable shipped third-party components, build tooling, reference-build dependencies, and CI supply-chain risk was verified.
blockers.requiredResolution: Determine the exact Stable distribution/build dependency boundary, run appropriate vulnerability and supply-chain checks, preserve the results, and resolve findings above the accepted threshold.

blockers.finding: No V1.6 Stable release security acceptance record currently proves every applicable security control as Passed, Not Applicable with justification, or an authorized exception.
blockers.requiredResolution: Create an exact-candidate security acceptance record after the applicable security evidence is complete. Unknown must remain blocking.

blockers.finding: The Release Candidate is source-qualified, but the exact Stable artifact/package/publication boundary, checksum/SBOM/provenance requirements, and final immutable release identity have not yet been established and accepted for V1.6 Stable.
blockers.requiredResolution: Define the supported Stable distribution artifact or source-release boundary, bind it to the exact approved source, generate applicable checksum/SBOM/provenance/signing evidence, and perform the controlled release transition only after all prior blockers close.

blockers.finding: The applicable deployment/production-acceptance and stabilization boundary for this shared design-system release has not been authoritatively resolved or completed for V1.6.
blockers.requiredResolution: Determine whether the shared design-system Stable boundary requires a published package/release acceptance, deployment acceptance, or a justified not-applicable disposition, then complete and retain the required evidence.

blockers.authority: GoreeCloud documentation, persistence, task-management, and Stable-qualification governance
blockers.finding: Canonical Drive Glaze UI task/changelog records remain older than the verified V1.6 Release Candidate transition and contain stale qualification language. Repository documentation is current, but the cross-system records are not yet fully reconciled.
blockers.requiredResolution: Reconcile the canonical GoreeCloud Drive change/task records to verified V1.6 RC and Stable-review state using the required current document format, preserving unfinished blockers and avoiding duplicate tasks.

nonBlockingBoundaries.finding: No downstream application inherits V1.6 conformance, Stable status, deployment acceptance, or production eligibility from this shared review.
This review does not publish an immutable tag or GitHub Release.

nextControlledPhase: Resolve Stable blockers and re-run an exact-candidate Stable qualification review before any Stable lifecycle transition.
boundary: The complete V1.6 24/24 qualification matrix and governed Release Candidate review are necessary evidence but do not satisfy the higher Stable qualification standard by themselves. Stable remains blocked while any listed blocker is unresolved or unverified.
